s_t: complete model state after t consumed tokens, including any required auxiliary state
h_t: D-dimensional hidden state of the restricted native diagonal recurrence
z_t: V logits after consuming token t
C_t: immutable encoded data body and its SHA-256 digest
k_t: context-and-exact-prefix lookup key, not checkpoint acceptance
R: representation expansion used to specify COW refinement
T,B,D,n: token length, checkpoint interval, hidden width, floor(T/B)
alpha,epsilon,eta: maximum retention, initial hidden approximation error, per-step error bound
